column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3629, owner D59): each prefix test builds its rig inside a t.Run per dialect, so the arms for the dialects this job does not configure skip while the one it does RUNS. Six tests, one skip per absent arm. Measured 2026-10-30 by running them with only PostgreSQL configured: `go test ./engine/ -run '<the six>' -json | grep '"Action":"skip"'`. The arms cannot be dropped: the finding is that a deploy check passing on one dialect's role failed on another's login (the first version failed every deploy through SQL Server's cleat_admin).
